The program was rejected because the forbidden-word check matched the word "input" in two comments. I removed it from those comments. I also moved some current from the tail to the output stage: 2 pF load × 25 MHz target, so p2 = gm7/CL needs more gm7.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Program rejected: forbidden-word check matched 'input' in comments. Comments reworded. Output-stage current raised to 18 uA (tail cut to 8 uA) to push p2 = gm7/CL toward the 25 MHz UGBW target, with Rz zero cancellation. Total supply current is 36 uA (64.8 uW, under 67 uW)."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (20.0, 14.0, 24.0),     # diff pair gm/Id (weak inversion for efficiency)
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # diff pair L (flicker noise area, gain)
    "itail": (8e-6, 6e-6, 12e-6),    # first-stage tail current
    "i7":    (18e-6, 12e-6, 19e-6),  # second-stage current
    "gmid7": (13.0, 9.0, 15.0),      # second-stage PMOS gm/Id
    "L7":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # second-stage PMOS L
    "L3":    (0.8, 0.5, 1.5),        # PMOS mirror-load L
    "ccf":   (1.15, 0.9, 1.6),       # Cc = gm1/(2*pi*28MHz) * ccf
    "rzf":   (1.0, 0.7, 1.5),        # Rz scale vs. p2-cancellation value
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    itail, i7 = p["itail"], p["i7"]
    gmidb, Lb = 12.0, 2.0                      # NMOS bias mirror family

    # bias / current sinks (same L and gm/Id -> accurate ratios)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmidb, Lb, iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmidb, Lb, itail, vds=0.3)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmidb, Lb, i7, vds=0.9)

    # diff pair and mirror load
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], itail / 2, vds=0.5, vsb=0.3)
    m3 = lut.size("p", 10.0, p["L3"], itail / 2, vds=0.9)
    # second-stage PMOS common source
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], i7, vds=0.9)

    gm1, gm7 = m1.gm, m7.gm
    ugbw_t = 28e6
    cc = gm1 / (2 * PI * ugbw_t) * p["ccf"]
    c1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd + 5e-15
    c2 = cl + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    # LHP zero on top of p2: z = 1/(Cc(Rz - 1/gm7)) = p2 ~ gm7/c2
    rz = (1.0 + c2 / cc) / gm7 * p["rzf"]

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)     # diode side
    n.dev("M2", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)    # output side (non-inverting overall)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "n1", "nc", rz)
    n.C("CC", "nc", "vout", cc)

    # predictions
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cc)
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * rz * c1)
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd))
    resid = gm7 / (2 * PI * c2) * 6.0
    pm = (90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3))
          - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * pmir)))
          - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / resid)))
    power = vdd * (iref + itail + i7)
    slew = min(itail / cc, i7 / (cl + cc))
    settle = 0.6 / slew + 4.6 / (2 * PI * ugbw * 0.8)
    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.05
    gm3 = m3.gm
    vn_th = math.sqrt(16 * 1.38e-23 * 300 / (3 * gm1) * (1 + gm3 / gm1))
    noise_1k = vn_th * 6.0
    cmrr_db = db(gm1 / max(m5.gds, 1e-12) * gm3 / max(m3.gds, 1e-12) / 10.0)
    psrr_db = gain_db - 3

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "slew": slew, "settle": settle, "swing": swing,
               "noise_1k": noise_1k, "cmrr_db": cmrr_db, "psrr_db": psrr_db}
```
